summary: Iteration 89 - Proposals, Contracts & Portal API Testing Complete. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all features: Proposals page with stats, table, status badges, create dialog with line items editor (recurring/one-time billing types), MRR/Setup/Tax/Total breakdown. Contracts page and Client Portal Admin page also verified.

issues: Console warning about chart width/height being -1 - cosmetic issue, charts still render

critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' on Contracts page - should use unique keys for list items
seed_data_creation: Test proposals created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 89 tested 3 high-impact revenue features: 1) Proposal Builder with full lifecycle (create→send→accept→convert-to-contract), 2) Contract enhancements (link-recurring, apply-price-increase, price-history), 3) Client Portal API (invoices, devices/health, summary). All backend APIs working correctly. Key endpoints: GET /api/proposals/stats (returns total, by_status, total_value, won_value, pipeline_value, win_rate), POST /api/proposals (creates with line_items having billing_type: recurring/one_time), POST /api/proposals/{id}/send|accept|decline|duplicate|convert-to-contract, POST /api/contracts/{id}/apply-price-increase, GET /api/contracts/{id}/price-history, GET /api/portal-api/{token}/invoices|devices/health|summary. Navigation: Proposals at /proposals, Contracts at /contracts, Client Portal at /client-portal.

proposal_stats.GET /api/proposals/stats: PASS - Returns total, by_status (draft/sent/viewed/accepted/declined/expired/converted), total_value, won_value, pipeline_value, win_rate

proposal_crud.POST /api/proposals: PASS - Creates proposal with line_items (recurring + one_time billing types), calculates subtotal/tax/total
proposal_crud.DELETE /api/proposals/{id}: PASS - Deletes proposal, returns 404 on subsequent GET

proposal_lifecycle.POST /api/proposals/{id}/send: PASS - Marks proposal as sent, sets sent_at timestamp
proposal_lifecycle.POST /api/proposals/{id}/accept: PASS - Marks proposal as accepted, sets accepted_at timestamp
proposal_lifecycle.POST /api/proposals/{id}/decline: PASS - Marks proposal as declined, sets declined_at timestamp
proposal_lifecycle.POST /api/proposals/{id}/duplicate: PASS - Clones proposal with new ID, (Copy) prefix, draft status
proposal_lifecycle.POST /api/proposals/{id}/convert-to-cont: PASS - Creates contract + recurring invoice from accepted proposal, marks proposal as converted

contract_enhancements.POST /api/contracts/{id}/link-recurring: PASS - Links contract to existing recurring invoice
contract_enhancements.POST /api/contracts/{id}/apply-price-inc: PASS - Applies percentage increase to contract and linked RIs, logs to price_history
contract_enhancements.GET /api/contracts/{id}/price-history: PASS - Returns price increase history array
contract_enhancements.Price increase validation: PASS - Returns 400 when no increase values provided

client_portal_api.GET /api/portal-api/{token}/invoices: PASS - Returns client invoices through portal
client_portal_api.GET /api/portal-api/{token}/devices/heal: PASS - Returns device health summary (total, online, offline, warning, devices)
client_portal_api.GET /api/portal-api/{token}/summary: PASS - Returns full client summary (client, devices, tickets, invoices)
client_portal_api.Invalid token handling: PASS - Returns 404 for invalid portal token

frontend_ui.Proposals page: PASS - Loads at /proposals with stats cards (Pipeline, Won Value, Win Rate, Drafts, Sent), proposals table, status badges, action buttons
frontend_ui.Create proposal dialog: PASS - Has client selector, title, summary, scope of work, line items editor with billing type selector (Recurring/One-Time), MRR/Setup/Tax/Total breakdown, contract term, payment terms, valid until
frontend_ui.Contracts page: PASS - Shows contracts with renewal alerts, SLA tiers, values, status
frontend_ui.Client Portal Admin: PASS - Shows client list with portal configuration
